name: Pts
role: TypeScript creative-coding library centred on points, geometry and vector math
summary: Modular library treating everything as points and groups of points, with geometry, intersection, interpolation, noise and animation helpers. Renders to Canvas or SVG (and other spaces), driven by a space with an animate callback. Output is Canvas pixels or SVG. Its strength is geometric computation as the primary idiom, written in TypeScript.
use_when: Geometry-first sketches: intersections, interpolation and point groups
Over p5.js when you want typed, modular geometry and vector math
Sketches that should render to either Canvas or SVG from the same code
Over canvas-sketch when you want a built-in geometry API
avoid_when: Largest example base and tutorials: p5.js
Many sprites or GPU effects: PixiJS
Video or GIF export out of the box: Ssam
Cleanly editable vector output with path booleans: Paper.js
notes: 2026-10-26: Release date of npm 1.0.3 was not retrievable; maintenance judged from a repository commit on 2026-10-21.
